title: "All reports" index lists reports the app's navigation hides from the persona, which then open empty
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 4 Marketing (report comment 6444160853 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D10; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-f5gugw` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/4-marketing/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

- **Sales rep:** the sidebar's Reports group shows 7; the *All reports* index lists all 10, and the three case reports open to "The dataset returned no rows for this report's scope" (`an-rep-reports.png`, `an-rep-report-cases_by_status_priority.png`).
- **Service agent:** the index lists the 4 opportunity reports that the nav hides (`visible: OPPORTUNITY_AUDIENCE` in HotCRM's app), and *Opportunities by Stage* opens empty (`an-agent-reports.png`, `an-agent-report-opportunities_by_stage.png`).
- The marketing user's index does drop the case reports, so some filter exists — but not the navigation's.

**Who loses:** personas are offered reports that cannot show them anything, and read "no rows" as "no data".

## Expected

The report index applies the same audience as the app navigation entries that name each report (or the report's own read access), so it never lists more than the persona can use.
